The PENALTY subtree is LIFTED from seeds/goal_residuals.json at build time, so if gr_move_penalty ever changes this seed goes out of date LOUDLY instead of silently diverging from the rule it claims to copy.
_SELF_LOAD_ONLY_RATIONALE: substrate/boot_all.py::_read_seeds GLOBS seeds/*.json and installs every match at boot -- so a file here is live in EVERY agent in the tree the moment it lands, and phase 2 is not a tree-wide-sweep rung. `self_load_only` is honoured by _read_seeds (it skips the manifest) while seed_loader.manifest_for reads it by path, so the seed is SELF-LOADED by whoever asks for it. This is the design's own §11 'safer for a first landing' route (the reading_collapse::_ensure_role_decode_loop precedent), chosen deliberately over the registry edit. REMOVING THIS KEY IS THE TREE-WIDE ACTIVATION and needs the paired sweep A5 requires.
description: ARC-GRAIN GOALS AS GRAPH DATA -- the positive to seeds/goal_residuals.json's negative. The six GoalResiduals hold arc-6's measured refutations; nothing in this tree held an OPEN goal above one task, so the residuals had nothing to steer and were inert BY CONSTRUCTION (results/arc6_goal_residuals.json -> GR1_collapse_live.unsignatured_candidates == {A: 0.0, B: 0.0}). This seed mints ArcGoal nodes from MEASURED sources (a STALE ceiling; a residual's MEASURED BLOCKER SPLIT; the four claims with no measured source; the agent's own SelfConcerns), extends the closed sig_seam vocabulary by the sd loop's own Occam ladder, ranks them in a weighted collapse whose value is ABSOLUTE HEADROOM IN TASKS, and ASKS -- under ignorance, never under refutation -- when the collapse is underdetermined. Every decision is a Rule or a Term. AG-5 (the executor: winner -> run -> artifact -> re-ingest -> epoch bump) is DELIBERATELY NOT HERE: without it this is a planning layer with no hands, and that is said rather than implied.

microtheory.name: arc_goal_minting
microtheory.description: Arc planning as graph data. A ceiling that has gone stale is a re-measurement goal; a measured blocker is a supply-the-blocker goal; an unrecognised blocker name is a vocabulary mint. A refutation the agent holds is a WEIGHT on the goal, never a veto -- pursuing an unreachable goal is how residuals get made; being confidently wrong where the residual is already held is not.

attrs.name: default_arc_goal_policy
attrs._authored_not_measured: w_* are AUTHORED policy, tunable as graph data without touching a rule -- the RESIDUAL_SCALE=100 precedent.
attrs._tie_break_is_MEASURED_not_lexical: The design asked for an explicitly pinned tie-break (agid lexical or minted_epoch) rather than an inherited one. MEASURED: this engine's Argmax returns the FIRST-INSERTED node under a tie, stably across repeated evaluation. A LEXICAL tie-break is NOT expressible with the shipped Term set -- there is no string ordering primitive and `sorted`-on-strings is a known-unfixed defect in this tree -- so the honest pin is the measured one, gated by re-running the same graph state and by rebuilding the same scene in insertion order. Recorded as a residual, not as a solved requirement.
attrs._w_unsignatured_rationale: An ArcGoal with no sig_seam cannot be matched by ANY GoalResidual (the lifted matcher requires a non-null sig_seam), so it escapes every refutation the agent holds. Without a cost, the cheapest way for the loop to evade its own evidence is to mint everything unsignatured. UNMEASURED beyond its two-position gate.

attrs.name: default_arc_ask_policy
attrs._rationale: The ask is a CANDIDATE IN THE SAME COLLAPSE, not a gate. margin_threshold is cascade_pick's Lt(margin, threshold) escalate-or-stay shape (seeds/escalation_rungs.json).

attrs.name: default_testimony_policy
attrs._rationale: A human answer becomes a GoalResidual with evidence_kind='utterance' so gr_condition_lapse/gr_condition_hold apply VERBATIM -- zero new lapse machinery. Testimony is not measurement, so reach_class_factor is replaced by this AUTHORED factor; and an answer naming no checkable condition gets fact_equals(arc_measure_epoch == <epoch at reply>), i.e. IT EXPIRES AT THE NEXT MEASUREMENT EPOCH. Angluin's zero-bits result made mechanical.

domains/goal_residual_ingest.DELIBERATELY_NOT_INGESTED -- four claims left out of the residual seed for having no measured source. Each is a measurement that does not exist yet. ALSO THE DESIGNED PROBE for the cheap-goal-convergence failure mode: these are the cheapest goals available, so if the collapse converges on them the value term is wrong, and that is OBSERVABLE.

attrs.name: sig_seam_aliases
attrs._rationale: RUNG 2 of the vocabulary ladder is 'the token is in the existing basis'. The basis map is a table of AUTHORED SeamAlias{token, alias_of} nodes -- NEVER string similarity. It ships EMPTY: specificity is an authored, auditable, COUNTABLE property.

The Agent node is created by whichever adapter booted, so a seed cannot ship an edge to it; this node CAN be shipped with its edges, and every arc rule binds it by matching agenda -uses_policy-> pol. Nothing about it is a decision -- it is the pool's identity.

rules.name: ag_mint_remeasure
rules.comment: AG-1, MINT SOURCE 'residual_stale'. A GoalResidual whose condition has lapsed mints ONE ArcGoal{kind:'re_measure'} carrying the residual's own signature and its MEASURED headroom in tasks. Mint-once via the 'remeasure_goal' edge (a MONOTONE latch -- this engine has no remove_edge). TWO SERIALIZERS, both load-bearing for DIFFERENT reasons: (a) the residual must BE the Argmin survivor over the eligible snapshot, because this engine applies effects against PRE-EFFECT reads, so two stale residuals in one pass would otherwise both mint; (b) the CONDITION must likewise be the Argmin survivor over this residual's own holds_under neighbours, because seam C has TWO conditions and the edge latch cannot help -- both bindings are collected before either effect applies. THE ANNIHILATION CHECK: this goal carries its SOURCE's signature, which would normally mean the source charges it its own full weight and mint and penalty cancel. It survives because the matcher's Exists requires Not(Eq(stale,1)) -- A STALE RESIDUAL CHARGES NOTHING. The existing matcher is correct for this case BY CONSTRUCTION, and ag_remeasure_retire handles the other direction.

effects._vocab_explained_note: a re-measure goal reuses its source's already-held signature, so the vocabulary ladder is satisfied at rung 1 by construction and never reaches the mint.

rules.name: ag_remeasure_retire
rules.comment: THE OTHER DIRECTION, and it is REQUIRED, not a nicety. gr_condition_lapse/gr_condition_hold are deliberately NOT latched, so a residual that lapsed CAN COME BACK. When it does, the re-measure goal it spawned is (a) obsolete and (b) suddenly charged its own source's full weight. Relying on the weight alone would leave a dead goal sitting in the pool forever. NOT a veto: retiring an obsolete re-measurement removes a request whose REASON has gone; it does not suppress a goal on the strength of evidence.

rules.name: ag_mint_blocker
rules.comment: AG-1, MINT SOURCE 'residual_blocker' -- FROM THE MEASURED BLOCKER SPLIT, NOT FROM reach_class. Measured, reach_class alone is nearly inert: all six residuals are operator_blocked and missing_dimension_ids == [], so the missing_dimension branch would mint NOTHING and the operator_blocked branch six 'rebuild the seam we just killed' goals. One level finer IS usable and is already on the node: seam A's reach_class_counts payload, read graph-natively with DictGet(FromJsonString(...)) -- no Python parse. 'Supply the structural primitive that blocks 42 tasks' is a DIFFERENT goal with a DIFFERENT signature from 'rebuild seam A', so there is no annihilation. And the blocker names are NOT sig_seam tokens, so this source FORCES the vocabulary ladder (AG-3) on real measured data rather than on a fixture. headroom_n IS the measured count -- in tasks. Mint-once by (source_kind, proposed_seam, rid) dedup rather than an edge latch, because ONE residual mints THREE goals and an edge latch on the residual would stop after the first.

rules.name: ag_mint_source_claim
rules.comment: AG-1, MINT SOURCE 'not_ingested' (design §4.3) -- cheap, honest, small, AND THE DESIGNED ANTI-GOODHART PROBE. Each of the four DELIBERATELY_NOT_INGESTED claims is a measurement that does not exist yet, i.e. exactly a goal, whose success criterion is unambiguous (a dotted path resolves). They are also the CHEAPEST goals available, so IF THE COLLAPSE CONVERGES ON THEM THE VALUE TERM IS WRONG -- and that is observable rather than argued. They are minted UNSIGNATURED (no sig_seam) and therefore pay w_unsignatured, which is what keeps a 1-task claim from outranking a 42-task blocker.

rules.name: ag_mint_self_concern
rules.comment: AG-1, MINT SOURCE 'self_concern' (design §4.4) -- ADMITTED AT A COST. The existing gap spine files SelfConcern{status:'noted'} with free-text content; routing it in is right, it is the tree's own 'the agent finds its own gaps' channel. WHAT MUST NOT HAPPEN is parsing that free text into a signature -- Seam C's failure exactly (the relation_all keyword variant 'recognised' 245 of 257 tasks; the cue set matched 'turn' inside 'reTURNs'). So the goal is minted WITH NO sig_* ATTRS AT ALL. It can be pursued (unsignatured candidates are charged 0.0 by the matcher, measured) but cannot be matched by any residual -- and it pays w_unsignatured for that illegibility. Being illegible to the evidence layer is a COST, not a free pass.

effects._unsignatured: no sig_* attrs, deliberately -- free text is never parsed into a signature.

rules.name: ag_vocab_recognize
rules.comment: VOCABULARY LADDER RUNG 1 -- EXACT RECOGNISE (the sd_recognize twin). The proposed token IS a held SignatureVocab{dim:'sig_seam'}: adopt it, and the ladder terminates here. Sets vocab_checked AND vocab_explained ATOMICALLY, so no deeper rung can ever see checked-without-the-look-having-happened. This engine has no rule ordering -- THE OCCAM ORDER IS THE GUARD CHAIN.

rules.name: ag_vocab_alias
rules.comment: VOCABULARY LADDER RUNG 2 -- IN THE EXISTING BASIS (the sd_transform_decode twin). The proposed token is a held SeamAlias{token, alias_of}: adopt alias_of. THE ALIAS TABLE IS AUTHORED GRAPH DATA AND SHIPS EMPTY -- never string similarity, never substring overlap. An alias that must be written down is countable and auditable; an alias inferred from characters is Seam C's 245-of-257.

rules.name: ag_dim_check_mark
rules.comment: RESILIENCE MARKER for the DEFERRED rung 3 (infer a new signature DIMENSION, not a new token in an existing one), copied from sd_dim_check_mark and required for the same MEASURED reason: the seed loader drops a rule WHOLESALE the moment any effect references an unknown Term, so an unlanded rung-3 rule would never install, dim_checked would NEVER be set, and ag_vocab_mint's guard would be permanently unsatisfiable -- deadlocking the mint for EVERY goal. Term-FREE twin: guard identical to the rung-3 rule's own, effect a plain literal. Deferring rung 3 lowers the closed-vocabulary ceiling from DIMENSIONS to TOKENS; it does not remove it.

rules.name: ag_vocab_mint
rules.comment: VOCABULARY LADDER RUNG 4 -- MINT (the sd_mint_quantum twin). THREE BOUNDS, NONE OF THEM A VETO. (1) PROVENANCE: the goal must carry a non-null evidence_artifact AND evidence_path, so a token can only be minted if it was QUOTED FROM A MEASURED ARTIFACT. No measurement, no token. THIS IS THE REAL BOUND -- the vocabulary grows only as fast as measurement grows -- and it is the anti-Seam-D guard (a per-task token would need a per-task artifact path). (2) MINT-ONCE + DEDUP: the vocab_minted edge latch, plus a (dim, token)-KEYED Not(Exists) rather than sd_mint_generator's one-per-boot form, plus the pcon_mint Argmin ONE-MINT-PER-PASS serializer -- without which two unrecognised tokens in one pass both mint, because effects apply against PRE-EFFECT reads. (3) NOVELTY IS PRICED, NOT FORBIDDEN: novelty_bits enters ag_select as -w_mdl*novelty_bits. A goal that needs a new word must OUT-EARN its novelty. Bumps arc_vocab_epoch so ag_revocab re-arms every unexplained goal -- the codebook_epoch shape.

rules.name: ag_vocab_refuse
rules.comment: THE MIRROR of ag_vocab_mint (the sd_dedup_existing pattern): a goal that reaches the mint point WITHOUT a resolving artifact path is REFUSED and reaches a TERMINAL status, so it neither re-scans every tick nor falls through to a 'did not resolve' read-back. Its guard is ag_vocab_mint's with the provenance items NEGATED, so exactly one of the pair fires. The refusal is LEGIBLE: the goal keeps proposed_seam and gains vocab_refused_because, so 'the agent wanted a word it could not source' is a readable fact and a candidate ASK region -- not a silent drop.

rules.name: ag_revocab
rules.comment: CLOSES THE VOCABULARY LOOP (the sd_redecode twin). A goal whose decoded_vocab_epoch is behind the agenda's arc_vocab_epoch re-arms and re-runs the ladder -- a token minted for one goal may be the EXACT recognition another goal needed, which is the whole point of a SHARED vocabulary. Clears the flags back to 0 EXPLICITLY, because this engine has no unset_attr and 0 is falsy for the Not(Eq(_,1)) guards. Scoped to goals that still have an unexplained proposed_seam, so a goal whose ladder already terminated is not churned every epoch (the sd_redecode asymmetry, deliberately NOT copied). dim_checked IS cleared -- the deferred rung 3 must get a fresh look once the vocabulary has grown.

rules.name: ag_select
rules.comment: AG-2, THE ARC-GRAIN WEIGHTED COLLAPSE. ps_move_select's RULE FORM at gap_priority's GRAIN, stated as a NEW selector rather than pretending otherwise. Argmax over every ArcGoal on the agenda that is BOTH un-terminal AND has strictly positive headroom (the earns-its-keep gate, ps_move_select's gap>0 twin), by value = w_headroom*headroom_n*reach_class_factor - w_residual*PENALTY(g) - w_mdl*novelty_bits - w_cost*cost_bits - w_unsignatured*[no sig_seam]. THE POOL/WEIGHT LINE IS THE WHOLE DESIGN: retirement and headroom>0 are Filter predicates; EVERY PIECE OF EVIDENCE (residual penalty, novelty price, illegibility cost) is inside the Argmax VALUE and appears in NO where and in NO Argmax source. That is the difference between a weight and a veto, made STRUCTURAL rather than promised. VALUE USES ABSOLUTE HEADROOM (denominator_n - honest_n, IN TASKS), NOT the residual weight's dimensionless ratio: the ratio is right for a PENALTY (how completely did this fail?) and WRONG as a VALUE, because it ranks row_verdict (denominator 15) EQUAL TO ir_retarget (257). PENALTY is gr_move_penalty's own subtree, lifted programmatically and alpha-renamed -- it is pure attr-equality over sig_seam/sig_lever/sig_target with residual-side wildcards, it never reads SignatureVocab and never reads the edge type, so it transfers to any node carrying sig_* UNCHANGED. But gr_move_penalty MATCHES ON THE has_move_candidate EDGE, so this rule is its own TWIN, not a reuse: the goal-residual doc's 'grain-agnostic' claim is true of the PREDICATE, not of the RULE. Computed INLINE, never read from an attr, so selection can never depend on whether an audit stamp has been written yet in the fixpoint.

rules.name: ag_select_audit
rules.comment: THE AUDIT STAMP -- the ps_move_sel_* shape, so the selection is READABLE. Binds the winner by its own stamped agid rather than re-deriving it, which is both the cheap form and the honest one: if this rule and ag_select ever disagreed about who won, the audit would be describing a different ranking from the one that fired (the ps_move_select five-expression precedent, inverted -- there the SAME Argmax is substituted into every expression; here the winner is named ONCE and every stamp reads that name). arc_sel_residual_penalty is the lifted PENALTY evaluated on the WINNER: a non-zero value here is the visible proof that a charged goal can still win, which is what makes the residual a weight and not a veto.

rules.name: ag_select_runner_up
rules.comment: THE MARGIN, which AG-4's T1 trigger is defined in terms of. Split out of ag_select for TWO reasons, both real. (1) SIZE: deriving the winner inside the runner-up's own pool predicate embeds the whole PENALTY subtree once per use and evaluates it once per pool element -- it took the emitted seed to 2.4 MB. Excluding the winner by its STAMPED agid is the same set, computed once. (2) ORDER: this engine has NO rule ordering, so the dependency ag_select -> ag_select_runner_up -> ag_ask has to be a GUARD CHAIN, and a guard that reads arc_sel_agid is that chain made explicit rather than hoped for. The margin is the ONLY thing AG-4 needs from the ranking, and it is stamped, so ag_ask never re-ranks.

rules.name: ag_select_margin
rules.comment: THE MARGIN ITSELF, with the runner-up bound by its stamped agid. Same reason as ag_select_audit: substituting the runner-up's whole Argmax into every slot of VALUE embeds the PENALTY subtree six times over and re-evaluates it per pool element. AG-4's T1 reads THIS number, and nothing else re-ranks.

rules.name: ag_ask
rules.comment: AG-4. THE ASK IS A CANDIDATE IN THE SAME COLLAPSE, NOT A GATE. This arc's own plan records the theorem: 'excluding a candidate yields ZERO BITS (Mitchell; Angluin's L*)'. An approve/deny gate is structurally a rejection with no counterexample -- ~1 bit and no reason. A QUESTION is the request for the counterexample. TRIGGER, all live graph reads: T1 the top two values are within ArcAskPolicy.margin_threshold (cascade_pick's Lt(margin,threshold) shape); T2 -- THE ONE THAT MATTERS -- Not(Exists(matching non-stale GoalResidual)) for BOTH tied candidates, i.e. IGNORANCE, NOT REFUTATION. Tied under refutation the evidence is already held and a human answer would be WEAKER than the ceiling on the node, so DO NOT ASK; tied under ignorance nothing is held either way, so ASK. That distinction is the SAME Exists term gr_move_penalty computes, NEGATED, so it costs nothing new. RATE BOUND: one open ArcQuestion per region per measurement epoch -- re-entry gated on NEW MEASUREMENT, never on graph churn (the codebook_epoch form). THE ASK NEVER BLOCKS A MINT: it writes no goal attr and touches no vocabulary guard; blocking is what makes a gate.

rules.name: ag_reply_mints_testimony_conditioned
rules.comment: THE REPLY IS EVIDENCE, NOT SCRIPTURE. An interlocutor Message responding to an ArcQuestion mints a GoalResidual -- THE SAME NODE TYPE AS THE SIX MEASURED CEILINGS -- with evidence_kind='utterance' and a holds_under edge to a ResidualCondition, so gr_condition_lapse / gr_condition_hold apply VERBATIM and ZERO NEW LAPSE MACHINERY EXISTS. Two things differ from a measured residual, both honest: the weight uses TestimonyPolicy.factor in place of reach_class_factor (testimony is not measurement, declared authored); and this branch is the one where THE REPLY NAMED A CHECKABLE REASON -- one of the three existing ckinds -- so that becomes the condition and the answer survives until its reason is falsified. The reply's structured condition fields are written by the world adapter as MECHANICAL TRANSLATION of an external form (the comp_topic precedent); the reply text is never parsed into a signature.

effects.weight_formula: TestimonyPolicy.scale * TestimonyPolicy.factor (AUTHORED -- testimony is not measurement)
effects._never_parsed: sig_* come from the QUESTION's region, never from the reply text. A string-derived signature is Seam C at arc grain.

effects.why: named by the reply -- a reason that can be falsified

rules.name: ag_reply_mints_testimony_unconditioned
rules.comment: THE DEFAULT CONDITION, AND IT IS THE POINT. A reply that names no checkable reason gets fact_equals(arc_measure_epoch == <epoch at reply>) -- SO IT EXPIRES AT THE NEXT MEASUREMENT EPOCH. That is Angluin's zero-bits result made mechanical: an answer with no counterexample carries ~0 bits and lasts one epoch; an answer carrying a reason persists until its reason is falsified. It is also the goal-residual doc's own rule -- 'a residual that cannot lapse is a lie with a long half-life' -- applied to the ONE source of residuals that has never been subject to it. The epoch is read as the STRING the ResidualFact stores, so the existing fact_equals branch of gr_condition_lapse consumes it unmodified. Guard is the conditioned rule's with the cond_kind item NEGATED, so exactly one of the pair fires.

effects.weight_formula: TestimonyPolicy.scale * TestimonyPolicy.factor (AUTHORED -- testimony is not measurement)
effects._never_parsed: sig_* come from the QUESTION's region, never from the reply text. A string-derived signature is Seam C at arc grain.

effects.why: the reply named no checkable reason, so it expires at the next measurement epoch -- an unconditioned answer is worth one epoch.

rules.name: ag_question_retire
rules.comment: An UNANSWERED question must retire (the note_experiments_exhausted / elaboration_exhausted pattern) so it neither blocks nor accumulates -- and an unanswered question is itself DATA: it says the loop ran without input. Retirement is by MEASUREMENT EPOCH, not by tick count, so it is monotone in information rather than in time.
